Hero.description: Ghostbyte is a small software studio based in Austria. We design and build websites, apps, and custom software that are fast, reliable, and made to solve real problems.

Projects.description: From mobile apps to web platforms — see what we've been building.
Projects.pixelix_description: An open-source mobile app for the Fediverse with a clean design and a focus on a great user experience.
Projects.github_release_stast_description: Github Release Stats is a tool to check the stats of Github repositories. You can check the download history of releases and the star history of repositories.
Projects.daily_tasks_description: A minimalist app that helps you prioritize your tasks each day using the Ivy Lee Method for better focus and productivity.
Projects.socialfolio_description: A simple, open-source way to share your socials in one place.
Projects.library_description: A collection of many useful websites and tools. They are sorted by category and include some tags to quickly find the right one for your needs.
Projects.veritate_description: A modern website for the Vienna-based metal band Veritate.
Projects.together_description: A tool for managing households and communities. Features are a shared shopping list, todos, calendar and more.
Projects.ferienhaus_lustenau_description: A website that helps guests discover and book a holiday home in Lustenau.
Projects.zahn_leitner_description: A clean and approachable website for a dental practice in Vienna.

Team.title: Our Team
Team.description: Ghostbyte is a small but dedicated team of developers passionate about creating innovative and high-quality digital experiences.
Team.daniel_description: Daniel is a developer passionate about crafting innovative and user-friendly software solutions.
Team.emanuel_description: Emanuel brings expertise in development and problem-solving, ensuring high-quality and efficient applications at Ghostbyte.
Team.locationsDescription: Our locations are Lustenau and Vienna. While we study in Vienna, we work on our projects from both places, staying connected to Vorarlberg as well as the capital.

Contact.title: Get in touch
Contact.description: Have a project in mind? Send us a message and let's create something amazing together.

Services.title: Our Services
Services.description: Whether you need a website, a mobile app, or a custom solution, we’re here to help. We combine thoughtful design with reliable technology to build software that fits your needs.
Services.mobile_development_description: We build mobile apps for iOS and Android using both native and cross-platform technologies. Whether it's a customer-facing app or an internal business tool, we focus on creating apps that feel fast, reliable, and easy to use. We can help with everything from the initial idea to publishing your app on the App Store and Google Play.
Services.web_development_description: We create websites and web applications of all sizes, from simple landing pages to larger platforms with custom functionality. Our goal is to build websites that load quickly, work well on every device, and are easy to update and maintain long after they're launched.
Services.seo_description: A well-designed website is only useful if people can find it. We build websites with search engines in mind by following modern best practices for performance, accessibility, and technical SEO. We also help improve existing websites to make them easier to discover.
Services.ui_ux_design_description: Good design is about more than making something look nice. We design interfaces that are clear, consistent, and easy to navigate, helping people accomplish what they came to do without unnecessary complexity. Every project is designed with real users in mind.
Services.maintainance_support_description: Launching a website or app is only the beginning. We provide ongoing support, whether it's fixing issues, adding new features, keeping dependencies up to date, or making improvements as your project grows. We aim to build long-term relationships and be available whenever you need us.
